messages:
Mira: weekend request  any curated non-english miniseries suggestions? planning a tiny living-room screening 
Jon: 'La Casa de Papel' (Spanish) is fun but obv mainstream. if you want obscure: 'The Returned' (French original 'Les Revenants')  eerie vibes
Priya: 'A Very Secret Service' (French)  it's a short goofy spy comedy, great palate cleanser between heavier stuff. pair with popcorn + herbed olives
Luis: try 'Trapped' (Icelandic). intense. serve with hot toddies or warm apple cider for the shivers 34e
Mira: love the mix. also thinking of doing a 3-episode arc 7:30-10pm, keeps it compact. snacks: popcorn + a sweet + savory option. ideas?
bot-snacks: suggested combo: sea-salt popcorn, sesame-caramel bites, and a small cheese plate
Jon: sesame-caramel sounds wild but yes. also: if anyone's into slow-burn horror, 'Monos' (Colombian film) is hypnotic 47b
Priya: Monos is great. for a shorter, surreal series: 'Inside No. 9' is English but anthology weirdness; non-english similar tone 4a1
Luis: voting time: which tone do we pick? 1) Eerie slow-burn 2) Light spy comedy 3) Tense procedural
Mira: :one: for eerie
Jon: :one:
Priya: :two: but fine with :one:
Luis: tally: eerie wins. let's do 'Les Revenants' pilot + 'Monos' short film interlude? chaotic but fits the evening
Mira: sold. I'll send calendar invite. bringing sesame-caramel and cider. anyone allergic to sesame?
Priya: nope all good
Jon: good to go. see you saturday 7:30pm
